paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 66b; Hyman reports that Yuchasin has Rava son of Rav Pappa, and the Rif reads Rafram bar Pappa.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Shabbat 66b paragraph names Rava bar Pappa. The Yuchasin Rava-son-of-Rav-Pappa and Rif Rafram-bar-Pappa alternatives are now expressly Hyman’s reports, without fresh collation of either book. The source’s full Rav Pappa title is retained, and no person, father, or name variant is silently merged.
